title: LatentRemedy: Efficient Remedy For Non-Prefix KV Cache Reuse in Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.18014v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Non-prefix KV cache reuse is a promising approach for improving inference efficiency in multi-agent systems as agents share the same context blocks. However, when agents have conflicting tasks, directly reusing non-prefix KV caches across agents can severely degrade model performance, causing up to a 90% drop. Existing remedies, including selective recomputation and offset-based calibration, recover a limited fraction of this loss. We argue that the problem lies not only in contaminated KV representations but also in the agent's difficulty interpreting reused context under its own instructions. To this end, we introduce LatentRemedy, which uses a few task-conditioned latent tokens to help the target agent leverage reused context without recomputing the shared block. translated_title: LatentRemedy：面向多智能体系统中非前缀KV缓存复用的高效补救方法
translated_abstract: 在多智能体系统中，非前缀KV缓存复用是一种很有前景的推理效率提升方法，因为多个智能体共享相同的上下文块。然而，当各智能体的任务存在冲突时，直接在智能体之间复用非前缀KV缓存会严重降低模型性能，性能下降幅度高达90%。现有的补救措施，包括选择性重计算和基于偏移的校准，只能恢复其中有限的一部分损失。我们认为，问题不仅在于被污染的KV表示，还在于智能体难以在其自身指令下正确理解被复用的上下文。为此，我们提出了LatentRemedy，它使用少量任务条件化的潜在token来帮助目标智能体在不重算共享块的情况下利用被复用的上下文。具体而言，我们使用一个MLP将目标前缀的最后隐藏状态映射为少量潜在token，这些token被放置在被复用的KV块之后进行交互。
tldr: 提出LatentRemedy方法，通过MLP将目标前缀的隐藏状态映射为少量任务条件化的潜在token并置于复用的KV缓存块之后，使多智能体系统在任务冲突场景下无需重算共享块即可高效复用非前缀KV缓存，解决了高达90%的性能下降问题。
en_tdlr: LatentRemedy uses an MLP to map the target prefix's last hidden state into a few task-conditioned latent tokens placed after the reused KV block, enabling efficient non-prefix KV cache reuse in multi-agent systems without recomputation even under conflicting tasks.
